items.title: Open Vulkan DLSS Reimplementation
items.oneliner: Cloneable Vulkan and WebGPU renderer reproduces DLSS-style neural upscaling with benchmarks, setup scripts, and downloadable code.

items.title: Self-Optimizing Local Inference Engine
items.oneliner: Local inference engine compiles kernels for your hardware and claims up to 2x llama.cpp speed on Apple Silicon.

items.title: Runnable Markdown For Shell Workflows
items.oneliner: Markdown notebook runs shell, SQL, and AI commands with persistent sessions, SSH access, and local-first installs.

items.title: Distance Field CAD IDE
items.oneliner: Experimental IDE lets you script solid models with distance fields and export meshes for CAD and 3D printing.

items.title: Wi-Fi Roaming Streaming Benchmark
items.oneliner: Hands-on benchmark shows multi-connectivity streaming with zero packet loss and 49 ms max delay during roaming.

items.title: Faster Separating Axis Collision Test
items.oneliner: Detailed Box3D write-up shows how inscribed spheres speed SAT contact generation for convex hull collisions.

items.title: Open Source C Plus Plus Frontend
items.oneliner: EDG's production C++ frontend is now public, giving compiler engineers a serious codebase to study and extend.

items.title: Open Source Sampler Hardware Stack
items.oneliner: Hardware and firmware files for a portable sampler are public, including a beta wavetable synth firmware.

items.title: StreetComplete iOS Beta Workboard
items.oneliner: Public issue tracker exposes the Kotlin Multiplatform migration plan for a real cross-platform mapping app.

items.title: Customizable Generative SVG Pattern Library
items.oneliner: Browsable SVG pattern collection gives designers and frontend developers ready-made generative assets they can tweak immediately.
